summary: Completed Module 10 Step 1 CONTEXT micro-exercise, analyzing container networking interface isolation (0.0.0.0 vs 127.0.0.1) and dynamic PORT environment injection in cloud deployments.
evidence: Container interface isolation: 127.0.0.1 binds exclusively to lo rejecting external eth0 proxy traffic with Connection refused and causing CrashLoopBackOff
Dynamic port injection: hardcoding ports causes platform reverse proxy health check timeouts (502 Bad Gateway) when process.env.PORT is ignored
Production standard: binding explicitly to app.listen(Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000, '0.0.0.0')
